arabic text: BHAI BHAI PUKARTI RAHI MAI,\nPHIR BHI KHANJAR NAHI RUKA AMMA
english translation text: I KEPT CALLING FOR MY BROTHER BUT THE DAGGER DIDN'T STOP, MOTHER

arabic text: SHIMR NE KI PHIR AISI GHUSTAKHI..\nMUJHSE DEKHA NAHI GAYA AMMA
english translation text: I COULDN'T WATCH SHIMR'S INSOLENCE, MOTHER

arabic text: TUM JO ZULFE SAWARA KARTI THI\nUNHI ZULFO MEIN HAATH THA USKA\nJAHA'N BOSE DIYE THEY NANA NE
english translation text: THE LOCKS OF HAIR THAT YOU USED TO BRUSH\nWERE THE SAME ONES SHIMR HELD\nWHERE THE PROPHET USED TO KISS

arabic text: USI GARDAN SE KHOO'N TAPAKTA THA\nSHIMR KHAIME TAK AAGAYA AMMA\nSARE SHABBIR YU UTHAYE HUE
english translation text: IS THE NECK WHERE BLOOD POURED\nCARRYING THE HEAD OF HUSSAIN\nHE REACHED OUR CAMP, MOTHER

arabic text: DEKH KAR MUJHKO BAYN KARTE HUE\nSHIMR HAR BAAR MUSKARATA RAHA
english translation text: SHIMR SAW ME LAMENT FOR HUSSAIN\nAND HE KEPT SMILING

arabic text: MERI NAZRO KE SAAMNE ZALIM\nWAAR GINKAR CHURI CHALATA RAHA
english translation text: I WITNESSED THE OPPRESSOR\nATTACK WITH THE KNIVES\nTHERE WERE PRECISELY…

arabic text: HAYE 13 ZARBE THI KUND KHANJAR THA\nAUR SHABBIR KA GALA AMMA
english translation text: 13 SWORDS AND A DULL DAGGER\nAND HUSSAIN'S THROAT, MOTHER

arabic text: CHARO JANIB SE GHER RAKHA THA\nTERE NOORE NAZAR KO LASHKAR NE\nTEER BARSATA THA KOI USPAR
english translation text: SURROUNDED FROM ALL 4 SIDES\nWAS THE LIGHT OF YOUR EYES\nSOME RAINED ARROWS ONTO HIM

arabic text: KOI PATTHAR SE MAARTA THA\nHAYE RET ZAKHMO PE WO GIRATA RAHA\nJISKO PATTHAR NAHI MILA AMMA
english translation text: SOME THREW ROCKS AT HIM\nAND THOSE WHO COULDN'T FIND ROCKS POURED SAND ON HIS WOUNDS, MOTHER

arabic text: HAYE JAB CHALAYA THA SHIMR NE KHANJAR\nMAINE AANKO'N SE APNI DEKHA THA\nHAATH APNE UTHAKE PEHLU SE
english translation text: WHEN SHIMR RAN HIS DAGGER\nI WITNESSED WITH MY OWN EYES\nYOU LIFTED YOUR HANDS

arabic text: HAATH APNE UTHAKE PEHLU SE\nTUNE SUKHE GALE PE RAKHA THA
english translation text: YOU LIFTED YOUR HANDS\nAND PLACED THEM ON HUSSAIN'S PARCHED THROAT

arabic text: UNGLIYA'N ZAKHMI HOGAYI HONGI\nHAATH MUJHSE TO NAA CHUPA AMMA
english translation text: YOUR FINGERS MUST BE INJURED\nDON'T HIDE YOUR HANDS FROM ME, MOTHER
